description: This file contains helper functions for integrating Twitter features within SuiteCRM, including checking module enablement, formatting tweets, replacing hashtags and user mentions with links, checking for duplicate entries, and handling Twitter OAuth authentication.

methods.name: check_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific module type is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: format_feed_tweets
methods.description: Formats a tweet's text for display, truncating if necessary and adding a link to the full tweet.

methods.name: replace_hashtags
methods.description: Replaces hashtags in tweet text with clickable links.

methods.name: replace_users
methods.description: Replaces user mentions in tweet text with clickable links.

methods.name: duplicate_check
methods.description: Checks if a tweet with the same description and date already exists in the database.

methods.name: check_auth
methods.description: Performs Twitter OAuth authentication flow, obtaining request tokens and generating login link.
